tool_input.command: cat src/lib/api-client.ts && sed -n 80,120p src/testing/mocks/utils.ts && cat src/components/ui/form/textarea.tsx | head -30 && git -C ../.. status --short && ls src/features/comments/ && grep -rn "delete-comment\|comments/" src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx | grep -v "^src/features/comments" | head
tool_input.description: Check api client, auth utils, and comment imports

result:
Comment editing is in place in `apps/react-vite`: an update-comment API, an Edit button with a form drawer on your own comments, and a success notification after saving. I did not run tests, lint, or the app, as you asked, so the changes are checked only by reading the code.

- **API:** `src/features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` adds `updateComment`, which sends `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with `{ body }`, and `useUpdateComment`, which refreshes the comments list on success.
- **Visibility:** a new `comment:update` policy in `src/lib/authorization.tsx` allows only the comment's author. Admins can delete others' comments but cannot edit them. Say if you want admins to edit too.
- **UI:** `src/features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx` is a drawer with a prefilled body field. `comments-list.tsx` shows it beside Delete, behind the new policy.
- **Success message:** `useUpdateComment` shows a "Comment Updated" notification. I put it in the hook because the features CLAUDE.md says success notifications go in `api/`. The existing create and delete components still notify from the component, so they don't follow that rule.
- **Mock:** `src/testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts` adds a PATCH handler. It updates only the body, only for the author's comment, and returns 404 when no comment matches.

No lint or test run was done, so formatting and type issues remain unverified.
